name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on preserving the memory of the victims of the post-war communist period in Slovenia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Slovenia to do more to remember people killed by the communist regime after the Second World War. It asks Slovenia to keep looking for hidden mass graves, give the victims a proper burial, and set up memorial sites. It also asks Slovenia to bring back a national remembrance day and to open the archives of the former Yugoslav secret services.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and opinions, not new rules.
- **Who it affects:** Slovenia's government and parliament, and families of the victims.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to Slovenia and other European Union bodies; they decide whether to act.
